words.plain: Sanctify [Greek: hagiazo] means to make holy — to set something apart and consecrate it for a sacred purpose, marking it as belonging to God. When Jesus asks the Father to sanctify his disciples through truth, he's asking that they be consecrated: set apart, made ready for the work he's sending them to do.
